sub_graphs.title: Prague: Gas Charging Mechanism
sub_graphs.description: Models the core gas charging and out-of-gas error handling

nodes.label: Gas Available for Operation
nodes.description: EVM has sufficient gas_left to potentially perform next operation

nodes.label: Charge Gas
nodes.description: Subtract gas amount from evm.gas_left

nodes.label: Gas Successfully Deducted
nodes.description: Gas charge completed, operation can proceed

nodes.label: Out of Gas Error
nodes.description: Insufficient gas, OutOfGasError raised

nodes.label: Check Gas Sufficiency
nodes.description: Compare required gas against gas_left

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Memory Expansion Gas
sub_graphs.description: Models memory allocation gas costs with linear and quadratic components

nodes.label: Current Memory Size
nodes.description: EVM memory currently allocated to a specific size

nodes.label: Calculate Memory Gas Cost
nodes.description: Compute gas cost for memory expansion: (size_in_words * 3) + (size_in_words^2 / 512)

nodes.label: Memory Cost Computed
nodes.description: Gas cost for memory expansion has been calculated

nodes.label: Extend Memory
nodes.description: Allocate additional memory to 32-byte boundary

nodes.label: Memory Extended
nodes.description: EVM memory expanded to new size

nodes.label: Calculate Expansion Delta
nodes.description: Compute additional gas needed beyond current allocation

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Storage Operation Gas Costs
sub_graphs.description: Models SSTORE gas costs with warm/cold and refund mechanics

nodes.label: Storage Slot Cold
nodes.description: Storage slot not accessed in this transaction

nodes.label: Storage Slot Warm
nodes.description: Storage slot already accessed in this transaction

nodes.label: Charge Cold SLOAD Cost
nodes.description: Charge 2100 gas for first access to storage slot

nodes.label: Charge Warm Access Cost
nodes.description: Charge 100 gas for subsequent access to storage slot

nodes.label: Charge Storage Set Cost
nodes.description: Charge 20000 gas for setting storage from zero to non-zero

nodes.label: Charge Storage Update Cost
nodes.description: Charge 5000 gas for updating non-zero to non-zero

nodes.label: Calculate Storage Refund
nodes.description: Compute gas refund for storage clearing (4800 gas)

nodes.label: Refund Added to Counter
nodes.description: Gas refund counter increased

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Blob Gas Economics (EIP-4844)
sub_graphs.description: Models blob gas pricing with exponential fee mechanism

nodes.label: Parent Excess Blob Gas
nodes.description: Excess blob gas from parent block header

nodes.label: Calculate Excess Blob Gas
nodes.description: Compute new excess based on parent and target

nodes.label: Excess Blob Gas Computed
nodes.description: Current block's excess blob gas determined

nodes.label: Calculate Blob Base Fee
nodes.description: Compute blob base fee using exponential formula

nodes.label: Blob Base Fee Set
nodes.description: Current blob base fee determined

nodes.label: Calculate Total Blob Gas
nodes.description: Multiply blob count by GAS_PER_BLOB (131072)

nodes.label: Calculate Data Fee
nodes.description: Multiply total blob gas by blob base fee

nodes.label: Data Fee Computed
nodes.description: Total data fee for transaction determined

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Message Call Gas Mechanics
sub_graphs.description: Models gas allocation for CALL operations including stipend and 63/64 rule

nodes.label: Message Call Initiated
nodes.description: CALL opcode executed, gas allocation needed

nodes.label: Charge Base Call Cost
nodes.description: Charge base cost plus account access costs

nodes.label: Charge Call Value Transfer Cost
nodes.description: Add 9000 gas if value is being transferred

nodes.label: Charge New Account Cost
nodes.description: Add 25000 gas if creating new account via value transfer

nodes.label: Calculate Max Message Call Gas
nodes.description: Apply 63/64 rule: max = gas_left - (gas_left / 64)

nodes.label: Call Gas Allocated
nodes.description: Gas for subcall determined (min of requested and max)

nodes.label: Add Gas Stipend
nodes.description: Add 2300 gas stipend for value-transferring calls

nodes.label: Subcall Ready to Execute
nodes.description: Subcall has allocated gas and can begin execution

ambiguities.text: The exact interaction between BLS precompile gas costs and the general gas charging mechanism is not fully specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume BLS precompile gas is charged upfront before execution, like other precompiles.

ambiguities.text: The 'fake_exponential' function name suggests approximation but the precision requirements are not stated
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume Taylor series expansion provides sufficient precision for economic calculations.

implicit_assumptions.description: Arithmetic operations for gas calculations do not overflow within uint256 bounds
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Overflow could lead to incorrect gas charging, potentially allowing free execution

implicit_assumptions.description: Gas refunds are bounded to prevent exploitation (capped at percentage of gas used)
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Unbounded refunds could enable gas token attacks or other economic exploits

implicit_assumptions.description: The 63/64 rule ensures sufficient gas is retained for cleanup after failed subcalls
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Parent context could run out of gas during cleanup, leading to inconsistent state
